content.text: {"route":"review","reason":"The record is a background summary of 28 claims, not the ROI itself, so adequacy cannot be fully judged. The FAD's stated reasons are thin and do not clearly show that key witnesses and comparators were addressed. For the non-selection (claim A), it says only that Complainant did not show he was more qualified than the two selectees, with no mention of interview scoring, selecting-official testimony, or comparator evidence. Many harassment claims (B1-B25, C2) are disposed of in one general finding of not severe or pervasive, with no claim-by-claim evidence. The FAD also cites claim \"B7\" for Colonel 1's comments, but those comments are claim B6, so the record is internally inconsistent. Claim B20 (alleged admission of reprisal) and the reprisal claims in general get no visible analysis of witness statements. A closer human look at the full ROI is needed."}
